plain_text:
If you are scaling the label template to be taller (long edge) the header and footer will need to be moved
manually. Follow the instructions below to move the header and footer in those instances.
semantic_text: If you are scaling the label template to be taller (long edge) the header and footer will need to be moved manually. Follow the instructions below to move the header and footer in those instances.

plain_text:
NOTE: If you use certain custom sized templates (i.e. 15x10, 18x10, etc.) on a regular
basis one option would be to run through this process once, then save the scaled
blank template with the header and footer in the appropriate places so that you
can go back to it and just add the label images when you need to use that particular
custom sized template.
